item.title: 14 · Master Claude Chat, Cowork, Code · 2026-04-13 · 12. The AI Constitution (Designing Guardrails with CLAUDE.md)
item.description:
Master Claude Chat, Cowork, Code · Host (solo; show also billed as "Beyond Prompting") · aired April 13, 2026 Method · HIGH priority · L1 Identity
Why it's here: Treats CLAUDE.md as the hard-rules constitution rather than a prompt dump, and names the failure mode most people hit: "instruction decay," where each extra rule makes behaviour less reliable. Exactly the discipline an IDENTITY file needs.
Original episode: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/12-the-ai-constitution-designing-guardrails-with-claude-md/id1882007947?i=1000761100958
